name: task_list
description: Read a page ordered in-progress, ready todo, blocked todo, then proposed and terminal tasks; default excludes both terminal statuses. Summary is default; request full list resources explicitly. Includes ephemeral Session observation, freshness and send eligibility; partial observations retain Task data.

parentId.description: Omit for all parents; null selects unparented tasks; a Goal UUID selects its direct children.

tagIds.description: Project tag UUIDs; applied with other filters before pagination or the ready limit. Empty means no tag condition unless untagged is true.

tagMatch.description: Match all selected tags or any selected tag; defaults to all.

untagged.description: Select resources without tags; conflicts with a nonempty tagIds set.

name: task_ready
description: Read at most limit ready Tasks ordered by creation time and UUID; default 5, maximum 20, without pagination. Summary is default; full includes complete Task descriptions.

parentId.description: Omit for all parents; null selects unparented tasks; a Goal UUID selects its direct children.

tagIds.description: Project tag UUIDs; applied with other filters before pagination or the ready limit. Empty means no tag condition unless untagged is true.

tagMatch.description: Match all selected tags or any selected tag; defaults to all.

untagged.description: Select resources without tags; conflicts with a nonempty tagIds set.

name: task_graph
description: Read the complete dependency graph or its dependency-only projection. Includes Session observations and the ordinary-member summary unless dependsOnly is true; external nodes do not contribute.
